Group specified document objects together

**Panel:** Comma → Util · **Nickname:** `GrpObj`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Objects | `O` | Geometry | List |  | Referenced Rhino objects to group |
| Group Name | `N` | Text | Item | `""` | Name for the new group (optional) |
| Create | `C` | Boolean | Item | `false` | Set TRUE to create the group |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Group Index | `I` | Integer | Item | Index of created group in the document (or -1 on failure) |
| Group Name | `N` | Text | Item | Name of the created group |
| Succeeded | `S` | Boolean | Item | True if group was created and objects added |
